text_markup: Other costs can contain [click] symbols without denoting an action.
text_plain: Other costs can contain {click} symbols without denoting an action.

examples.text_markup: The ability "[click]: Gain 1[c] and draw 1 card." on {card:Professional Contacts} is an action. The ability "Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability." on {card:Eli 1.0} is not an action and is used during a paid ability window.
examples.text_plain: The ability "{click}: Gain 1{c} and draw 1 card." on Professional Contacts is an action. The ability "Lose {click}: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability." on Eli 1.0 is not an action and is used during a paid ability window.
